source: Fernhill Studio supplier contract playbook v3 (fictional)

clauses.title: Payment terms
clauses.note: We pay within 45 days at most.
clauses.fallback: Customer will pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Termination for convenience
find: terminate this agreement at any time
clauses.note: We must be able to leave on 30 days' notice.
clauses.fallback: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice.

clauses.title: Automatic renewal
clauses.note: No automatic renewal; renewals are signed.
clauses.fallback: Any renewal requires a written agreement signed by both parties.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.note: Supplier must return or destroy our information at the end.
clauses.fallback: On termination, each party will return or destroy the other's Confidential Information.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.note: The cap is at least 12 months of fees.
clauses.fallback: Either party's total liability will not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

clauses.title: IP indemnity
clauses.note: Supplier indemnifies us for IP claims.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.note: A DPA is signed when personal data is processed.

clauses.title: Insurance
clauses.fallback: Supplier will maintain professional liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per claim.
